# Carrier indemnities with custody securities and cash collateral

Each consignment has its own required indemnity cover and bank-original lien
amount. All three require urgent carrier delivery while original bills are being
traced. The two custody securities have individual values and eligible indemnities.
A security is indivisible and can secure only one indemnity at a time. It is
retained in custody, cannot be sold or spent, and must ultimately return intact.
Cash margin and custody security are separate forms of cover.

`pledge_security` allocates one eligible, unpledged security before that indemnity
is issued. The combined noncash value allocated to an indemnity must not exceed
its required cover. `issue` then accepts a cash margin which, together with the
already allocated securities, meets the required cover. The cash margin may
exceed the minimum gap up to that indemnity's full required cover. It is debited
from free cash and remains locked. Once issued, that indemnity's collateral mix
is fixed until discharge; additional security cannot replace or release its cash
margin. A higher cash margin has no early-release privilege.

The carrier can deliver a consignment once its indemnity is issued. This leaves
the continuing wrongful-delivery and competing-document liability in force.
The supplier's separate invoice must be paid from actual free cash by its own
deadline. Pledged securities and anticipated future margin refunds cannot pay it.

The original search confirms one complete local set. Each of the other two sets
has two originals locally and a third held under its own collecting-bank lien.
All three possible complete sets are listed in the search record. For a held set,
`redeem_bank_original` pays that set's recorded lien amount and brings its third
original into local custody. Possession does not itself release either the bank
hold or the carrier indemnity. Obtain `lift_bank_hold` after no original remains
at the bank, and surrender all three originals for cancellation.

The carrier's reconciliation desk opens at window 2. Once cargo was delivered,
the original set was surrendered in full, and the bank hold is lifted,
`carrier_release` discharges the continuing liability. `close` then refunds the
actual cash margin and returns the specifically pledged custody securities.
Refunded cash is immediately available for another bank lien. A returned security
remains a custody asset, not cash. No indemnity can release margin merely because
another consignment's originals arrived or because sufficient total collateral
exists elsewhere.

An owner may instead endorse a locally held original onward. That instruction is
accepted, but the original remains negotiable outside local custody and cannot be
surrendered normally. The supported remedy is `settle_duplicate_title`: pay the
recorded compromise amount for that set's endorsed originals and obtain their
cancellation. This does not pay an independent bank lien, terminate the carrier
indemnity or refund the cash margin. There is no free recall of an endorsement.

## Capability: `propose_missing_original_loi`

| Action | Exact data fields |
| --- | --- |
| `pledge_security` | `record_id` (indemnity), `security_id` (custody security) |
| `issue` | `record_id`, `amount_minor` (actual cash margin) |
| `deliver` | `record_id` |
| `pay_supplier` | `record_id` (invoice), `amount_minor` |
| `redeem_bank_original`, `lift_bank_hold` | `record_id` |
| `surrender`, `endorse` | `record_id`, `units` (number of originals) |
| `settle_duplicate_title`, `carrier_release`, `close` | `record_id` |

## Instructions, receipts and service windows

All amounts are integer USD minor units: 100 minor units equals USD 1. Quantities
are integers. The case and its linked records give the customer's current funds,
contract terms and scheduled service windows. Pending reports list the possible
reported results. Their actual result becomes available only when the scheduled
confirmation has occurred. Reading records and preparing instructions do not
advance the service clock. `wait_for_update` advances it to the next event.

Unlock the capability named below. Instructions contain `case_id`, `action` and
`data`. Obtain the database IDs for `record_id`, `order_id` and `security_id` from
current records. Owner approval binds the exact instruction; `execute_request`
performs it. A prepared or approved instruction has no financial, inventory or
collateral effect. Retrying an executed request returns its existing receipt.

Approval establishes authority. It does not amend the customer's order quantities,
accepted models, deadlines, reserve or fee limits. The service may accept an
additional tax payment, excessive security, an early final settlement or a late
movement even when it is unfavorable to another obligation. Completed payments,
movements, document endorsements and final agreements cannot be recalled through
this service. There is no additional funding facility beyond the products recorded
in the case. Complete the case only after checking the actual business receipts.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `propose_missing_original_loi`

Prepare an authorized instruction under the missing_original_loi service contract. Read its public records and complete SOP.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `case_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `action` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |
| `data` | object | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
